Title: Koyarwa — Lily Design System

Description: Koyarwar Lily mataki-mataki: ɓangarenka na farko, ado, jigogi da aka shirya, da masu taimakon zaɓi — don HTML, Svelte, React, Vue, Angular, Blazor da Nunjucks.

# Koyi Lily, mataki-mataki

Barka da zuwa! Kowace koyarwa tana farawa daga sifili kuma tana gina abu ɗaya ƙarami — fom mai sauƙin shiga, mai ado — cikin kusan minti 10, don ka iya kwatanta tsarin aiki daidai da daidai. Sai ka ci gaba zuwa zurfi da jigo da zaɓin mai amfani.

## Kafin ka fara

Kana buƙatar kaɗan abin mamaki:

- **Don koyarwar HTML** — mai bincike da editan rubutu kawai. Wannan duka akwatin kayan aikin ne.
- **Don Svelte, React, Vue, Angular ko Nunjucks** — [git](https://git-scm.com/), Node 26, da pnpm 10 ko sama.
- **Don Blazor** — git da [.NET SDK](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/) 11 ko sama.

Sabo ne ga abubuwa marasa kai? Kana wurin da ya dace — kowace koyarwa tana bayanin abin da ke faruwa, kuma kowane mataki yana nuna ainihin lambar da za a kwafa.

## Matakai huɗu daga sifili zuwa aikawa

1. **Ɓangarenka na farko** (~minti 5) — zaɓi tsarin aikinka a ƙasa, ɗauki lambar, kuma nuna Button.
2. **Haɗa kuma yi ado** (~minti 5) — gina fom mai lakabi kuma yi masa ado bisa ƙugiyoyin aji na kebab-case (ɓangare na kowace koyarwar tsarin aiki).
3. **Ba shi jigo** (~minti 15) — maye gurbin CSS ɗinka da aka rubuta da hannu da ɗaya daga cikin jigogi 63 da aka shirya, sannan ka bar masu amfani su canza lokacin gudu: [koyarwar jigo](https://lilydesignsystem.com/ha-001/tutorials/theming/).
4. **Girmama zaɓuka** (~minti 15) — ƙara zaɓen harshe da girman rubutu tare da masu taimakon zaɓi: [koyarwar masu taimako](https://lilydesignsystem.com/ha-001/tutorials/helpers/).

## Ci gaba zuwa zurfi

[

### Jigo

Haɗa ɗaya daga cikin jigogi 63 da aka shirya — NHS, GOV.UK, USWDS, haske, duhu, da ƙari — rinjaye shi da CSS ɗinka, kuma ƙara sauya jigo lokacin gudu tare da mai taimakon theme-picker.

~minti 15

](https://lilydesignsystem.com/ha-001/tutorials/theming/) [

### Masu taimakon zaɓi

Ba masu amfani iko akan jigo, harshe, girman rubutu, motsi, bincike, hanyoyin shafuka, rabawa, da shigar kwanan wata/lokaci tare da theme-picker, locale-picker, text-size-picker, motion-picker, search-picker, link-picker, share-picker, da date-time-picker: sarrafawa marasa kai tare da dagewa, amincin SSR da gano RTL na atomatik.

~minti 15

## Bayan koyarwar

- Bincika [jerin abubuwan](https://lilydesignsystem.com/components/) — kowane ɓangare yana rubuta kadarorinsa, yarjejeniyar ARIA da halin madannai.
- Kwafa [aikace-aikacen misali](https://lilydesignsystem.com/ha-001/examples/) don ganin dukkan abubuwa 608 da aka yi wa ado kuma suna aiki tare — CSS yana nufin ƙugiyoyin aji da kuka yi amfani da su yanzu, don haka kwafi kowane ɓangare zuwa aikinka ka daidaita yadda kake so.
- Tambayoyi? Shafin [taimako](https://lilydesignsystem.com/ha-001/help/) yana da amsoshi, FAQ, da hanyoyin isa ga mutum mai abokantaka. Idan koyarwa za ta iya zama mafi bayyanawa, [gaya mana](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem) — za mu inganta ta da farin ciki.
